verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of official desktop sync clients for macOS or Windows, and nothing on selective sync or on-demand (online-only) files; the docs cover only the Drive API (uploads, push notifications, permissions), which are developer building blocks rather than this capability. One community comment mentions Google's 'sync to local' software on Mac being unreliable, but that glancing reference does not document Windows support, selective sync, or online-only files.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files
